details: On June 18, 2026, the presidents of the U.S. and Iran signed an interim peace deal, extending a ceasefire by 60 days to negotiate a final truce. This development has led to a dip in oil prices and steady Asian stocks, though uncertainties about the deal's full implementation and potential U.S. threats to resume attacks if commitments aren't honored persist. While some earlier reports noted a general rise in cryptocurrency markets due to optimism around the peace talks and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, more recent analysis indicates that the crypto market has remained cautious, with Bitcoin and major altcoins experiencing mixed performance or slight declines. The Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates steady but signal a possible hike later in the year, coupled with inflation concerns, appears to be tempering investor enthusiasm for risk assets like cryptocurrencies, despite the geopolitical progress.
title: US and Iran Sign Interim Peace Deal, Impacting Oil and Crypto Markets
